user_authority: User directed layer separation on 2026-08-30: environment and object images must contain no retained glyph or magic-writing layer; a separately composited glyph overlay is used only when runtime state requires it. This authorizes candidate generation, not final runtime-asset lock.

visual_layering_contract.environment_background: A reusable opaque place-only image. It contains architecture, light, plants, water, furniture, and silhouettes but no glyph, magical handwriting, spell trail, rune, or blue/violet magic cue.
visual_layering_contract.target_object: A reusable transparent object-only image. It contains ordinary physical condition only; frost, wear, or a material crack must not be presented as active spell writing or a target-selection answer cue.
visual_layering_contract.glyph_overlay: A separate transparent, non-semantic air-ink accent. It may be shown or hidden by runtime state but never encodes a functional word, target, number, button, outcome, or confirmed spell selection.
visual_layering_contract.semantic_glyph_owner: Live Godot glyph-input and result UI own all recognised letter/spell meaning. A static bitmap must not claim the semantic result of direct player writing.
visual_layering_contract.composition_order: EnvironmentBackground -> SituationLayer targets -> MagicWritingOverlay -> live Story/Spell/Preview/Result UI
visual_layering_contract.input_rule: EnvironmentBackground and MagicWritingOverlay use MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE; only explicit target and UI controls receive input.

common_constraints: Soft Storybook Cel 2D Hybrid; warm learner-led magic academy; fixed landscape presentation.
All functional copy, numeric values, controls, and localization remain live Godot UI.
Direct magic writing is blue-to-blue-violet handwritten air ink, not text emitted from a book.
No glyphs, magic writing, magic trails, rune shapes, or blue/violet spell cues may be baked into environment or target source artwork.
No empty decorative UI frames, automatic target/commit signal, 3D exploration, horror framing, waves, logos, or watermarks.
Source candidate files are not imported by a Godot scene and are not release, store, or marketing assets.

license.terms: OpenAI Terms of Use and applicable Service Terms; exact underlying model/version is not surfaced by the built-in generation tool.
license.input_rights: Only user-approved GRIMOIRE canon and project-owned prompt direction were used. No third-party or user-provided image was supplied as a generation input.

assets.primary_use: A 90-120 second admissions entry that opens the academy promise without permanent choice, automatic spell grant, or a baked magic-writing cue.
A safe first FLOW-writing class with a readable water-channel response, a clear live-input area, and no baked spell cue.
One equal-priority, recoverable seedling concern for explicit target selection after circuit preview; it has natural frost only and no magical state cue.
One equal-priority, repairable greenhouse support and lantern concern for explicit target selection after circuit preview; it has physical wear only and no magical state cue.

A low-opacity, optional visual accent for recognised direct handwriting and preview states. It must remain hidden for admission idle and class idle; live runtime owns all semantic glyph/word information.
assets.state_family_status: HIDDEN__STROKE_RECEIVED__CANDIDATE_RECOGNIZED__PREVIEW__RESULT; source candidate supplies only a non-semantic accent for recognised/preview states

superseded_variants.reason: The transparent alpha was valid, but the diffuse light field and broad stroke distribution did not satisfy the user-directed restrained direct-writing presentation.
